name: B10-0224/2024 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Temirlan Sultanbekov, an opposition party leader in Kyrgyzstan, and other pro-democracy activists held in detention. It says the charges against him may be politically motivated and that his health is at serious risk after more than 28 days on hunger strike. It also urges Kyrgyzstan to drop the charges and asks European Union diplomats to raise these concerns with the Kyrgyz authorities. The text is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands the release of Sultanbekov and other activists.
- **Who it affects:** Kyrgyzstan's authorities, opposition activists and civil society.
- **What happens next:** European Union diplomats and member states are asked to raise the case with Kyrgyzstan.
